raw_posts.name: RankSpot
raw_posts.tagline: Pay-as-you-go SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents
raw_posts.description: RankSpot is the SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. Connect the MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in 2 minutes and your agent does the work: it writes articles from what already ranks on Google in 100+ languages, publishes them, and pitches ranking sites from your mailbox for backlinks. Run every client or business from one chat. No subscription: $3 an article, $0.004 a prompt check, reading your data free. Start with $1 of credit and a free article.

raw_posts.name: Creatify Max
raw_posts.tagline: Your ad teammate, from strategy to creation to launch
raw_posts.description: Max is your teammate for paid ads. Share a product URL or brief and Max makes video ads, sets up campaigns on Meta and TikTok, and watches results 24/7, flagging what to fix next. You make the calls: nothing goes live without your approval.

raw_posts.name: TheBold
raw_posts.tagline: Turn execution into meetings with investors
raw_posts.description: TheBold turns startup execution into direct investor access. 🎉 Launch Fast Track (Nov 17–27): pass one AI investor-readiness interview, land in the deal flow of investors who match your startup, and unlock direct meeting access. TheBold helps founders understand investor criteria, track and verify execution and traction, practice investor-specific AI simulations, and book meetings once qualified.

raw_posts.name: Appxiom
raw_posts.tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
raw_posts.description: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

raw_posts.name: EkLine
raw_posts.tagline: AI SEO for Developer Tools and API first companies!
raw_posts.description: Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it. EkLine helps your API or developer tool succeed at both. Its AI agents audit your website, docs, GitHub, and community content to find what AI misunderstands or can't implement. Then they prioritize gaps, write code-grounded fixes as pull requests your team approves, and retest AI responses to measure what improved.

raw_posts.name: Versine
raw_posts.tagline: Let your AI send and receive money. We're Venmo for agents.
raw_posts.description: Send and receive money with AI. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Instinct, Muse, or your own agent through our MCP. Recipients don’t need a Versine account: they can cash out straight to their bank. Each transfer is approved by your passkey or sent autonomously to trusted contacts that you set.

raw_posts.name: superlog
raw_posts.tagline: Finds the production bugs your monitoring never sees
raw_posts.description: Your monitoring only alerts on what you told it to watch, so customers still report bugs. Superlog finds the errors nobody set an alert for, investigates them 24/7 and hands you a fix. 100+ startups use it; 87% of our fixes get merged.

raw_posts.name: VINC
raw_posts.tagline: Bring your filmmaking vision to life.
raw_posts.description: You know the scene, the mood, the camera movement, and how your film should feel. VINC helps you work on the rest. Develop your script, sketch your storyboard, plan and generate your shots, with room to review and refine at every stage. Finally, bring all your generated shots into the built-in editor, where SFX and BGM are taken care of, and deliver your final output.

raw_posts.name: seshka
raw_posts.tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
raw_posts.description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

raw_posts.name: Superhands
raw_posts.tagline: Design the system, not every output.
raw_posts.description: Design’s deliverable is now the system, not the output. Turn your designs into guidance that agents follow in every AI tool your team uses. See what they produce, and fix the system once instead of chasing every output.
